reviews.title: Disappointing postpartum
reviews.text: Their ig marketing oversells the actual content. The circuit workouts I tried felt unnatural and unengaging. Short video transitions felt carelessly spliced together. Disappointed because I had high hopes for this. Unfortunately I was preoccupied and didn’t cancel sooner.

reviews.title: False free

reviews.title: Always crashes
reviews.text: This app would be great if it didn’t crash half the time. More often than not I can’t even get in the app, it just loads for ages before shutting down. This happens too often, and it has been going on for ages. I paid a subscription and it’s basically a lottery every time I want to use the app. Unless the developers solve this issue for good I would advise against paying for this app.

reviews.title: App crashes
reviews.text: The app crashes or takes an extremely long time to open.

reviews.title: Disappointed with glitching
reviews.text: I have been a sweat subscriber for over 7 years. The range of workouts and trainers are great. Unfortunately in the last 6 months the app has been very slow to load and often crashing and not loading at all.   The app has also been struggling to link in with my Apple Music as it was previously. This is very disappointing and I am tempted to look elsewhere
